title: Mavericks open home schedule against Spurs Saturday at American Airlines Center
text:
Mavericks open home schedule against Spurs Saturday at American Airlines Center
The Dallas Mavericks host Victor Wembanyama and the San Antonio Spurs at 7 p.m. Saturday, Oct. 24, in their first home game of the season. It is the third straight season the Spurs have been Dallas' home-opening opponent, and San Antonio won all four meetings last season.
The Dallas Mavericks will play their first home game of the season against Victor Wembanyama and the San Antonio Spurs at 7 p.m. on Saturday, Oct. 24, FOX 4 reported.
It is the third straight season Dallas will play San Antonio in its home opener. The Mavericks open the season on the road against the Houston Rockets on Oct. 21 at 7:30 p.m. Central time, marking the 47th season in team history. The NBA released the Mavericks' 82-game schedule on Thursday, Aug. 13. The schedule includes 21 nationally televised games, with the first on Oct. 28 on ESPN.
Saturday's game is at American Airlines Center, and Dallas plays at Indiana on Oct. 23 before returning home for the Spurs game, according to ESPN's Mavericks schedule. After the home opener, the Mavericks travel to play the Miami Heat on Oct. 26.
San Antonio won all four meetings between the teams last season, according to ESPN's 2025-26 Mavericks schedule. The Spurs beat Dallas 125-92 at American Airlines Center in the 2025-26 home opener on Oct. 22, 2025, and won 135-123 in Dallas on Feb. 5, 2026. San Antonio also won 138-125 on Feb. 7 and 139-120 on April 10 at home.
Dallas and San Antonio are scheduled to meet again on Feb. 9, 2027, according to the Mavericks' 2026-27 schedule as reported by FOX 4.
